archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) mixed with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast)

layout_rules.spacing: Generous spacing. Sections use py-24 to py-32. Containers use p-6 to p-8.
layout_rules.grid: Bento Grid Protocol. Mode A (Tetris Grid) for marketing visual sections. Mode B for Pricing and feature dense areas.
layout_rules.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-aligned dense content. Center-aligned Hero optional but preferred left-aligned text with right-aligned visual mockup.
layout_rules.container: Max width 7xl, mx-auto, px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

components_instructions.navbar: Sticky header with Crystal Glass effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-white/40). z-50. Includes Logo ('Wraft'), Nav Links, and 'Sign In'/'Sign Up' CTAs leading to /dashboard. Mobile menu using hamburger.
components_instructions.hero: Split layout. Left: H1 (emphasizing AI WhatsApp agent for local business), Subtitle, CTA buttons (Primary solid green, Secondary outline). Right: Custom animated product demo mockup built with HTML/Tailwind/Framer Motion (No video). It should simulate a chat UI receiving a question in Hindi/Kannada and the AI replying based on uploaded docs.
components_instructions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. 'Editorial Ribbon' style. Low contrast background (bg-accent_sage/10), dark text. Large spacing (gap-32). Content: Supported languages (Kannada, Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, etc.).
components_instructions.features_bento: Asymmetric bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Show setup steps: 1. Upload Doc/Website URL. 2. AI Trains instantly. 3. Customer chats on WhatsApp. Use subtle glassmorphism or neumorphism. Inject WhatsApp Green (#25D366) specifically when showing the WhatsApp integration part.
components_instructions.how_it_works_sticky: Vertical sticky scroll section. Use Framer Motion to create a sticky scrolling effect where cards stack over each other as user scrolls down. Each card highlights a step (Setup, Train, Deploy, Support).
components_instructions.competitor_comparison: Grid/Table comparing Wraft vs Chatbase. Use 'Grid Borders' (The Technical Look). Emphasize Wraft's 2000 messages on Standard plan (way more affordable). Use checkmarks (Lucide icons). Highlight the Wraft column with a subtle green background or border.
components_instructions.pricing: 4 columns for Free, Standard, Pro, Business. Highlight 'Standard' (₹999 / 2000 msgs) and 'Pro' (₹1899 / 8000 msgs). Pricing cards should use 1px subtle border, soft shadow on hover, with prominent green CTAs.
components_instructions.testimonials: Social proof section using the provided images. Simple clean cards with a quote, business owner name, and their photo.
components_instructions.footer: Dark contrast. Deep charcoal background (#0A0A0A) with white/gray text. Massive space (py-24). Large 'Wraft' logo text at the bottom. Columns for links.

motion_guidelines.hover_states: All interactive elements must have hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white). Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-1).
motion_guidelines.scroll_animations: Use Framer Motion (whileInView) for staggered entrance of bento items and pricing cards. Recommend installing lenis for smooth scrolling.
motion_guidelines.custom_animations: Simulated typing effect and message pop-ups in the Hero chat UI mockup.

abstract_green_bg.description: Abstract green shapes, use with very low opacity (10-20%) as a background texture in the Hero or Features section.

chat_mockup.description: Mobile app interface, use as a fallback if HTML mockup is insufficient, or within a bento grid card.

testimonial_1.description: Elderly clinic owner smiling. Use for testimonial.

testimonial_2.description: Indian local business owner smiling. Use for testimonial.

testimonial_3.description: Indian store owner smiling. Use for testimonial.

media.icons: lucide-react for standard icons. Use pure HTML/CSS for chat bubbles.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='pricing-standard-btn').
